plots.cum.none: No cumulative analysis for this run (set an ordering column in the plan, e.g. year).
plots.cum.legendStep: cumulative pooled estimate up to this study
plots.cum.help: Each row shows what the pooled effect would have been if only the studies up to that point (by the key) existed. If the estimate settles early and only narrows later, the result is stable; if one study shifts it abruptly, check that study. Enter: details of the added study.
plots.bubble.none: No meta-regression (moderator) for this run, so there is no bubble plot.
plots.bubble.aria: Bubble plot: effect by {moderator}, with the fitted meta-regression line and CI band
plots.bubble.ariaCat: Dot plot: effect by groups of {moderator}
plots.bubble.help: If the line slopes, the effect changes with the moderator. The band shows how certain the fitted line is; interpret cautiously with few studies (rule of thumb: < 10 per moderator). Meta-regression is an observational association across studies, not proof of causation. ←/→: move between studies, Enter: details.
plots.bubble.helpCat: Per group the study effects and the group summary (diamond with CI). Different groups may suggest different effects, but this is an observational association. ←/→: move, Enter: details.
plots.bubble.keys: Keys: ←/→ move between studies, Enter: study details.
plots.cum.keys: Keys: ↑/↓ move, Enter: details of the added study.
